examples.en: After two late night sessions, the Security Council has failed to reach agreement.
examples.zh: 开过两次深夜会议之后，安理会仍未能达成协议。

examples.en: "Through one of the sessions, I discovered my personal bias," he recalls.
examples.zh: “在其中一次会议中，我发现了我个人的偏见。”他回忆道。

examples.en: Doing so reduces the possibility of idle sessions being hijacked by another user.
examples.zh: 这样做可以降低空闲会话被另一个用户窃取的可能性。
